data.name: Holy Valkyrie ExS-TIA TS
data.detailed_description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

  • Single-ending visual novel with 20 minutes till credits

    STORY

    As the ExS-TIA face defeat at the hands of Naioro, Souma Shihou activates the ExS-TIA system and manages to bring him down. But due to some reaction with the device, Souma's body is transformed into that of a woman's. With Marina and the others still out of commission, Souma takes it upon himself to battle the remaining monsters.

    CHARACTER


    Souma Shihou
    Having activated the ExS-TIA system himself in order to fight, his body is transformed into that of a woman's as a result.

    Marina Katsuragi
    As Souma is the only one left able to fight, she provides him with support alongside everyone else.

    Leese
    As Souma is the only one left able to fight, she provides him with support alongside everyone else.

data.short_description: From hit Japanese visual novel developer Lusterise! Due to the effects of the system, Souma Shihou has transformed into a woman. With others' support in combat, she fights alone against the remaining monsters.
